japan1.title: 大手航空2社 燃油サーチャージ再度引き上げ 燃料価格高騰で
japan1.description: 全日空と日本航空は、国際線の運賃に上乗せする燃油サーチャージについて、7月の発券分から引き上げると発表しました。5月と6月の発券分も引き上げていましたが、燃料の高騰が続いていることを受けての対応だとしています。

japan1.title: Booking.comの予約客に不審なメッセージ相次ぐ 注意呼びかけ
japan1.description: 日本ホテル協会は、宿泊予約サイト「Booking.com」を通じてホテルを予約した客に、クレジットカードの情報を入力させようとする不審なメッセージが届く事例が相次いでいるとして、注意を呼びかけています。

japan1.title: 円相場 小幅な値動き 1ドル＝160円台前半での取り引き
japan1.description: 12日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は小幅な値動きとなり、1ドル＝160円台前半での取り引きが続きました。

japan1.title: スーパーのコメ平均価格 5キロ 税込み3644円 3週連続値下がり
japan1.description: 全国のスーパーで6月7日までの1週間に販売されたコメの平均価格は、5キロ当たり税込み3644円と前の週より29円下がりました。値下がりは3週連続で、銘柄米の下げ幅が大きくなっています。

japan1.title: 生命保険の営業職員 新たな呼び名は「ソナエルジュ」に
japan1.description: 家庭や職場を訪れて保険を販売し、生保レディーとも呼ばれた営業職員について、生命保険協会は、新たな呼び名を「ソナエルジュ」にすると発表しました。性別にとらわれず、顧客に寄り添うという仕事内容が表現されているとしています。

japan1.title: 自民対策本部 南米EPA交渉なら“農業に配慮を”政府に申し入れ
japan1.description: 南米の関税同盟「メルコスール」と日本との間のEPA＝経済連携協定について、自民党の対策本部は仮に交渉を始める場合、国内農業への影響を避けるため、牛肉をはじめとした重要な品目に十分配慮することなどを政府に申し入れました。

japan1.title: 株価 一時2800円超上昇 イランへの攻撃中止表明受け
japan1.description: 12日の東京株式市場、アメリカのトランプ大統領がイランへの攻撃を中止したと明らかにしたことなどを受けて、日経平均株価の上昇幅は一時、2800円を超えました。

japan1.title: 東京株式市場 キオクシアHDの時価総額が国内首位に
japan1.description: 12日の東京株式市場で、半導体・フラッシュメモリの世界大手、キオクシアホールディングスの株価が上昇し、時価総額がトヨタ自動車を上回って国内首位になりました。

japan1.title: “来月 原油代替調達で去年並み確保も対策進める”経産相
japan1.description: ホルムズ海峡を経由しない代替ルートでの原油の調達で来月は中東情勢が悪化する前の去年とほぼ同じ量を確保できる見込みとなったことについて、赤澤経済産業大臣は12日の閣議のあとの会見で、必要な量の確保など原油の安定供給に向けた対策を引き続き進めていく考えを示しました。

japan1.title: 改正郵便法が成立 郵便料金を柔軟に変更可能に 値上げも検討
japan1.description: 日本郵便で郵便事業の赤字が続いていることを受けて、料金を総務大臣の認可によって改定できるようにする郵便法の改正案が、12日開かれた参議院本会議で可決・成立しました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz6月12日(金) 半導体量産へ“3つの課題”とは
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: 日銀植田総裁の入院“金融政策決定会合に影響ない”片山財務相
japan1.description: 日銀の植田総裁が感染症で入院したことについて、片山財務大臣は、来週開かれる金融政策決定会合への影響はないという認識を示しました。

japan1.title: 水田政策見直しで説明会開催へ 鈴木農相“生産者の意見を”
japan1.description: コメの安定供給を目指して、政府は主食用の生産を抑える機能を果たしてきた補助金の見直しなどを決めました。これを受けて鈴木農林水産大臣は、今月から各地の説明会で生産者の意見を聞き、具体的な仕組みの検討に生かす考えを示しました。

japan1.title: NYダウ900ドル超値上がり イラン攻撃中止表明で買い注文広がる
japan1.description: 11日のニューヨーク株式市場では、アメリカのトランプ大統領がSNSでイランへの攻撃を中止したと明らかにしたことで買い注文が広がり、ダウ平均株価は前日から900ドルあまりの値上がりとなりました。

japan1.title: ANA 新運賃体系に問い合わせ殺到 窓口対応や返信に遅れ
japan1.description: 全日空は先月導入した国内線の新しい運賃体系などに対する問い合わせが相次ぎ、窓口の電話がつながりにくくメールの返信にも時間がかかっているとしてホームページで謝罪しました。

japan1.title: 日系企業 レアアースなど輸出規制の運用透明化を中国に要望
japan1.description: 中国に進出している日系企業の団体は、中国政府による軍民両用の品目の日本向けの輸出規制について、民生用の分野でも、レアアースなどの調達に支障が出ているとして、運用の透明性を高めるよう要望しました。

japan1.title: 三井住友FGなど金融大手 アンソロピック・NECとAI連携を発表
japan1.description: 国内の銀行、証券、保険の大手各社は、アメリカの新興AI企業、アンソロピックとNECが作る連携の枠組みに参加し、セキュリティー対策や金融サービスの高度化に向けた取り組みを進めていくと正式に発表しました。国内の大手企業の間でAI開発をリードする企業との連携が加速しています。

japan1.title: 中国地方 中東情勢悪化で旅客船の減便・値上げ相次ぐ
japan1.description: 中東情勢の悪化による燃料価格の高騰を受けて、中国地方では旅客船の減便や値上げが相次いでいます。

japan1.title: 北陸新幹線延伸 8ルートの費用対効果の試算まとめる 国交省
japan1.description: 北陸新幹線の新大阪までの延伸ルートをめぐり与党の委員会による再検証が進む中、国土交通省が8つあるルートについて費用対効果の試算をまとめたことがわかりました。東京と新大阪間の全線で見た場合「小浜・京都ルート」が最も高い一方、未着工区間に限れば、「米原ルート」が最も高くなっています。

japan1.title: 円相場 小幅な値動き 1ドル＝160円台半ばで取り引き
japan1.description: 11日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は小幅な値動きで、1ドル＝160円台半ばでの取り引きが続きました。

japan1.title: 自動車業界でEVやエンジン車など「混流生産」の動き広がる
japan1.description: EV＝電気自動車の需要が減速する中、自動車業界ではEVとエンジン車など駆動方式の異なる車を同じ生産ラインで作る「混流生産」の仕組みを導入する動きが広がっています。

japan1.title: 株価 荒い値動き 半導体関連銘柄など買い戻す動きも
japan1.description: 11日の東京株式市場、イラン情勢が再び悪化するとの懸念から日経平均株価は一時、1800円以上値下がりしました。しかし、その後は半導体関連など値下がりした銘柄を買い戻す動きも出て、荒い値動きとなりました。

japan1.title: 半導体量産目指すラピダス 英伊の公的機関と技術開発協力へ
japan1.description: 先端半導体の量産化を目指すラピダスは半導体の研究を進めるイギリスとイタリアの公的機関と技術開発の協力に向けた覚書を交わす見通しになったと明らかにしました。半導体の設計に強みを持つ現地の企業からの受注の獲得が期待できるとしています。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz6月11日(木) 新技術IOWN 将来性と今後の焦点は
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: NYダウ 950ドルを超える値下がり 5万ドルを割り込む
japan1.description: 10日のニューヨーク株式市場では、イラン情勢が再び悪化するとの懸念から幅広い銘柄に売り注文が出て、ダウ平均株価は950ドルを超える値下がりとなり、5万ドルを割り込みました。

japan1.title: NTT 次世代のIT技術 実用化や事業展開が課題に

eu2.title: UK economy shrinks in April as the Iran war energy shock takes a toll
eu2.description: Britain's economy contracted by 0.1% in April, the first monthly fall since August 2025, as the conflict in the Middle East pushed up energy costs and prompted households to rein in their spending.

eu2.title: OpenAI opens Madrid office to speed up ChatGPT expansion
eu2.description: The company behind ChatGPT will open an office in Madrid to strengthen its European presence and work more closely with Spanish firms, developers, research centres and institutions.

eu2.title: SpaceX's stock market debut: Five risks investors need to know
eu2.description: SpaceX makes its Nasdaq debut this Friday in the largest flotation in history, but analysts warn that a sky-high valuation, weak shareholder rights and mounting losses could leave retail investors exposed.

eu2.title: Portugal triggers EU budget safeguard clause over energy crisis
eu2.description: The EU safeguard clause allows member states to cover energy-related costs in response to the crisis, just as they did in the field of defence.

eu2.title: Senior MEP fears Airbus-Boeing dispute could reignite EU-US tensions
eu2.description: German MEP Bernd Lange fears the end of a crucial corporate truce could give the US grounds to breach the Turnberry agreement, which the European Parliament is expected to adopt next week.

eu2.title: ChatGPT can now buy things for you after deal with payments giant Visa
eu2.description: Visa has embedded its payment network inside ChatGPT, letting the chatbot independently shop and complete purchases on your behalf.

eu2.title: Anthropic pledges more than €170 million to study AI's impact on jobs
eu2.description: Anthropic unveiled a research fund and a policy roadmap for governments to follow if AI pushes unemployment sharply higher, with the CEO suggesting taxes on AI firms could one day fund a universal basic income.

eu2.title: Stickers, shirts and beer: 2026 World Cup could earn Portugal up to €945 million
eu2.description: Despite not hosting a single match, Portugal could see nearly €1 billion in economic benefits from a World Cup increasingly driven by digital engagement and consumer spending, according to a new study.

eu2.title: From welder to wealthy: SpaceX IPO could make thousands of employees millionaires
eu2.description: The stock market debut of Elon Musk's AI and space company could make thousands of SpaceX employees significantly wealthier, including some of the firm's lowest-paid staff.

eu2.title: 'Partners and friends’: Trade and defence top of agenda at EU-South Korea summit
eu2.description: As security threats grow and geopolitics shift, the European Union and Republic of South Korea have celebrated a new Digital Trade Agreement at a summit in Brussels.

eu2.title: Airbus-led consortium to launch German-backed fighter jet project after FCAS collapse
eu2.description: An Airbus-led alliance of eight defence firms will launch Team Gen 6 in Berlin, a German-backed sixth-generation fighter jet project intended to replace the collapsed Franco-German-Spanish FCAS programme, AFP reports.

eu2.title: Buying a home in Spain now requires over 8 years of full salary
eu2.description: House prices rose 20.5% in 2025, while wages edged up just 1%. The Balearic Islands and Madrid are where buying a home demands the greatest financial effort.

eu2.title: Germany: growth halves as state drives investment
eu2.description: The energy shock is further slowing economic growth and fuelling prices. The DIW institute has halved its growth forecast. Fiscal expansion may soften inflation but cannot fully offset it.

eu2.title: Trump envoy tells Tokayev he has a ‘friend in the White House’ amid US minerals push
eu2.description: The United States and Central Asian countries are seeking to advance investment projects in critical minerals as Washington looks to diversify supply chains for materials considered essential to national security and reduce dependence on China, which dominates much of the global market.

eu2.title: Who works the hardest in Europe? The countries with the longest and shortest working weeks
eu2.description: People in some European countries work nearly eight hours more a week than those in others, according to Eurostat. Experts point to collective bargaining, part-time work and economic structure as key drivers of the gap.

eu2.title: Spain trapped in rental crisis: up to half of wages go on housing
eu2.description: An estate portal study shows the average wage share has risen 12 percentage points since 2019. Madrid and Catalonia, with 70% of pay, top the regional ranking.

eu2.title: Airbus-led group proposes fighter jet alternative after French-German project fails
eu2.description: The FCAS programme had been viewed as a flagship European defence project, aimed at strengthening military cooperation as Europe faces a more assertive Russia.

eu2.title: German industrial output rises for the first time this year but is still 'too little'

eu2.title: How much is EU trade with the US falling?

eu2.title: ChatGPT maker OpenAI files for IPO, joining Anthropic and SpaceX in race to go public

eu2.title: France and Germany abandon joint fighter jet project as companies unable to reach agreement
eu2.description: The project was seen as a key test of European efforts to work more closely on defence as they seek to present a united front in the face of a hostile Russia at a time of souring ties with the United States.

eu2.title: Le Havre: 38,000 fake trainers destroyed after 15-year court case

eu2.title: Wizz Air announces Starlink wifi deal as other budget rivals hold back

eu2.title: Intesa Sanpaolo launches bid for Mps bank, merger set for December 2026

eu2.title: The jet fuel shock wipes out half of the global airline industry's expected profits

eu2.title: The €3trn question: Can markets handle SpaceX, OpenAI and Anthropic all at once?

eu2.title: Exclusive: Inside the EU’s struggle to police China's tariff circumvention
eu2.description: As the EU moves to strengthen its defences against cheap Chinese imports, some Chinese companies are openly advertising ways to bypass EU duties, from transhipment to minimal product transformation. Euronews looks into the methods circulating online.

eu2.title: EU must act before China cripples European industries, warns EPP chief

eu2.title: Google rents SpaceX/AI supercomputers for $920M a month, ahead of IPO

aus1.title: Live: Dolphin double act has Roosters on the ropes
aus1.description: Two tries to the Dolphins has them in control in their clash with the Sydney Roosters. Follow live.

aus1.title: Port River 'stud muffin' among spate of dolphin deaths in Adelaide
aus1.description: Environmental authorities are investigating what caused the death of a Port River dolphin, believed to be Zoom, this week after several dolphin carcasses washed up on Adelaide beaches in recent days.

aus1.title: Alleged drug dealer caught after trading cannabis for cat food
aus1.description: Police charge a 45-year-old woman with a range of drug, weapons and other offences after a group of teenagers were caught stealing cat food to allegedly swap with her for cannabis.

aus1.title: Two dead after Taliban opens fire on dress code violation protest
aus1.description: The protest followed the arrests of dozens of women for alleged dress code violation in the Afghan city of Herat.

aus1.title: Federal mines minister backs unions' right to strike at BHP
aus1.description: Federal Resources Minister Madeleine King says workers threatening strike action at the nation's biggest port deserve "every single cent" of what they earn while a peak industry body says they are "letting down everyone".

aus1.title: Mitre 10 franchisee battles to stop Bunnings opening next door
aus1.description: A small town retailer is battling it out with Australia's biggest hardware giant in the Federal Court to stop Bunnings from opening up literally next door to his Mitre 10 franchise.

aus1.title: Live: Cats putting wasteful Suns to the sword at Kardinia Park
aus1.description: Geelong kicks seven-straight goals to take control of a crucial clash with Gold Coast. Follow live.

aus1.title: Police dog puts alleged fugitive bikie in hospital
aus1.description: A Top End bikie who allegedly escaped police custody last week has been hospitalised after being bitten by a police dog during his re-capture.

aus1.title: No sympathy for ‘juvenile grubs’ in detention centres, Qld deputy premier says
aus1.description: Jarrod Bleijie says children inside youth detention centres are largely to blame for lockdowns, and it's the staff that need protection.

aus1.title: Parton says Canberrans are 'more vulnerable' after budget's release
aus1.description: The Canberra Liberals and the ACT Greens issue their responses to the ACT budget, criticising the government's fiscal plan, principally around cost of living, transport and overall management of the territory's finances.

aus1.title: Ivan Milat suspected in 11 additional murder, missing persons cases
aus1.description: A parliamentary inquiry has heard a police taskforce identified 11 unsolved homicide and missing persons cases with potential links to Ivan Milat.

aus1.title: Unsecured creditors of iconic music festival to get 11c in the dollar
aus1.description: The iconic Byron Bay music festival may have been trading while insolvent for months before it collapsed, according to a new liquidator's report.

aus1.title: Queensland sugar miller aims to reopen next week following cyber attack
aus1.description: Mackay Sugar tells growers it is aiming to restart cane processing early next week, after a cyber attack forced it to stop on Wednesday.

aus1.title: Prison term 'inevitable' for former school principal, court hears
aus1.description: A former school principal is staring down a prison term after robbing a "vulnerable" teenage girl of her innocence, a Tasmanian court has heard.

aus1.title: Wild scenes in Mexico City as fans fill the streets after World Cup opener
aus1.description: Thousands of Mexican fans spill onto the streets of Mexico City after El Tri's opening World Cup triumph against South Africa.

aus1.title: Killers of Greenbushes man show no remorse during sentencing
aus1.description: A judge said the men, who were convicted of killing 68-year-old Raymond Smith during a drug-fuelled home invasion in the WA town of Greenbushes, showed no remorse.

aus1.title: Billionaire says $150m court loss no reason to change approach to native title
aus1.description: Mining magnate Andrew "Twiggy" Forrest has defended his company's approach to Indigenous agreements after a court ordered the miner to pay $150 million in compensation to the Yindjibarndi people.

aus1.title: Australian sprinter's death in Thailand came weeks after her 25th birthday
aus1.description: The brother of Stawell Gift finalist Jemma Stapleton remembers her "bright smile" and expresses gratitude for the outpouring of grief and support.

aus1.title: Court hears of 'tragic mistake' that caused fatal Canberra crash
aus1.description: The daughters of a motorcyclist killed in Canberra's north tried to reach him for their nightly phone call as he lay dying on the road, an ACT court has heard.

aus1.title: Ex pro cyclist Rohan Dennis reported for driving while disqualified, ABC understands
aus1.description: Rohan Dennis was handed a suspended sentence last year for the events leading up to the death of his Olympian wife Melissa Hoskins in December 2023.

aus1.title: 21yo man stabbed to death in crowd in Tennant Creek street
aus1.description: Police have arrested a 17-year-old boy after a man was fatally stabbed in a street in Tennant Creek overnight.

aus1.title: Medical care of Floreat double-murderer to be focus of inquest
aus1.description: The main focus of a coronial inquest into the death of a Perth mother and her daughter will be the medical care their killer Mark Bombara received in the lead up to the double-murder suicide, a coroner reveals.

aus1.title: Socceroos coach Tony Popovic signs extension through to Asian Cup
aus1.description: Socceroos coach Tony Popovic gets his contract extended just days before Australia's World Cup kicks off to take the national team through to next year's Asian Cup.

aus1.title: Why this fashion designer sells her clothes on social media not shops
aus1.description: Katharina Mildren's clothes have attracted legions of fans online and she ships items around the world, but there is one place you will not find her garments: in a shop.

bd3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bd3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bd3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bd3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bd3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bd3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bd3.title: CU admin identifies 2 molesters
bd3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bd3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bd3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bd3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bd3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bd3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bd3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bd3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bd3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bd3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bd3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bd3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bd3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
